ABOUT THIS VEHICLE

Prestige Imports / Lamborghini Miami is delighted to offer this 2022 Lamborghini Urus for sale!

Combining breathtaking supercar performance with everyday practicality, the Urus delivers an exhilarating driving experience that has redefined the luxury performance SUV segment. Powered by a twin-turbocharged 4.0L V8 producing 641 horsepower and 627 lb-ft of torque, the Urus accelerates from 0–60 mph in approximately 3.5 seconds while offering exceptional handling, confident all-wheel-drive capability, and unmistakable Lamborghini character. Its aggressive body lines and commanding stance ensure it stands out whether cruising through the city, arriving at an exclusive automotive event, or embarking on a weekend getaway. Inside, the driver-focused cabin features premium Italian leather, advanced touchscreen technology, and exquisite craftsmanship, creating an environment that blends race-inspired performance with everyday luxury. Designed for enthusiasts who refuse to compromise between versatility and excitement, the Lamborghini Urus remains one of the most desirable high-performance SUVs ever built.

Contact Prestige Imports / Lamborghini Miami to make this Urus yours today. Sales Price includes dealer fee of $1447.50 and $299 electronic filing fee. Tax, tag, title and registrations fees are not included and are calculated at time of purchase.
